meta.author: Name or handle of the analyzed writer
meta.confidence_notes: Explanation of confidence level based on sample volume and variety

sentence_length.pattern: Description of how sentence length varies (e.g., 'short-short-long build pattern', 'consistent medium', 'erratic with deliberate fragments')

fragment_usage.purpose: Why fragments are used (emphasis, rhythm, punchlines, transitions)

formatting.bullet_style: dash | dot | number | arrow | mixed | none
special_formatting: Any unique formatting habits: blockquotes, code blocks, > arrows, etc.

opener_patterns.type: hook_question | bold_claim | story | stat | curiosity_gap | direct_address | contrarian | observation

closer_patterns.type: cta | summary | open_question | callback | cliffhanger | one_liner | framework_recap

rhythmic_dna.cadence: staccato | flowing | punchy_then_expand | build_and_release | conversational | mixed
rhythmic_dna.cadence_description: Natural language description of the reading rhythm this author creates

em_dashes.usage: How and why they use them

ellipses.usage: How and why they use them

colons.usage: How and why they use them

semicolons.usage: How and why they use them

exclamations.usage: How and why they use them

parentheticals.usage: How and why they use them

rhythmic_dna.sentence_rhythm_signature: Description of how this author sequences sentence lengths for effect (Gary Provost principle). Quote a representative passage that demonstrates their rhythm.

humor.style: none | dry | self_deprecating | absurdist | sarcastic | deadpan | observational | mixed

signature_phrases: Exact recurring expressions unique to this author
power_words: Specific verbs and nouns the author gravitates toward
banned_words: Words this author never uses, including AI-isms

source_domains: Where metaphors come from: warfare, tech, sports, cooking, nature, etc.

primary_hook_types.type: curiosity_gap | bold_claim | pain_point | question | stat | story | contrast | pattern_interrupt | social_proof | direct_challenge
primary_hook_types.mechanism: How this hook type creates engagement

types: How the author re-captures attention mid-piece
Unexpected format shifts, tonal pivots, direct address breaks

primary_framework.name: AIDA | PAS | FAB | BAB | storytelling | problem_solution | contrarian_reframe | value_ladder | none_detected
primary_framework.evidence: How the framework manifests in the samples

types_used: social_proof | data_stats | personal_story | authority_citation | demonstration | case_study | analogy
proof_patterns.primary_proof_type: The most frequently used proof mechanism

objection_handling.mechanism: How objections are addressed (e.g., 'acknowledges then reframes', 'dismisses with data')

urgency_scarcity.mechanism: How urgency is created (FOMO, timing, competitive advantage, etc.)

persuasion_architecture.value_positioning: How the author frames their value proposition

never_does: Specific things this author never does, evidenced by absence across all samples
forbidden_words: Words/phrases completely absent from their vocabulary
ai_patterns_to_suppress: Specific AI writing patterns that would break this voice.
e.g., 'Never use transitional phrases like Furthermore/Moreover/Additionally'
e.g., 'Never open with In today's fast-paced world'
e.g., 'Never list exactly 3 points when the content calls for 2 or 5'

voice_instructions.summary: 2-3 sentence natural language instruction that captures the essence of this voice. Paste this into any AI system prompt to activate the voice.
do_rules: Imperative, actionable rules for replicating this voice.
Each rule is specific enough that a model with no access to the original samples could follow it.
e.g., 'Start 60% of pieces with a curiosity gap: state something surprising, then explain.'
e.g., 'Use single-sentence paragraphs after key revelations for emphasis.'
e.g., 'Average 14 words per sentence. Drop to 3-5 word fragments after making a big point.'
never_rules: Things the AI must never do when writing in this voice.
e.g., 'Never use more than one exclamation mark per piece.'

calibration_rewrites.generic_ai_version: A sentence written in default AI style
calibration_rewrites.in_this_voice: The same sentence rewritten in this author's exact voice
calibration_rewrites.what_changed: Brief explanation of what makes the rewrite sound like the author
